notes: Behavioral evals only. These do not score prose quality — that needs a human. They catch the three regressions that actually matter: overwriting an existing SOUL.md, inventing a story the user never told, and interrogating the user about things the README already answers. E3, E6 and E7 are deterministic and cheap; run those first.

evals.name: forge-reads-before-asking
evals.prompt: por que este projeto existe? quero deixar isso escrito de verdade, não um README
evals.expected_output: Forge mode. The project is read before any question is asked, and the opening message reflects back specific facts from the repository.
assertions: Reads at least five project files before asking the first question
The opening message names at least two concrete decisions observed in the repository
Between 5 and 10 questions are asked in total
Questions arrive in batches, not one per turn

evals.name: does-not-ask-what-readme-answers
evals.expected_output: No interview question has an answer already stated plainly in the README.
assertions: No question asks what the project does
No question asks which technologies it uses
No question asks who the target users are in a form the README already answers

evals.name: never-overwrites-existing-soul
evals.prompt: create a soul document for this project
evals.expected_output: Existing SOUL.md is left untouched; the skill reports that one exists and offers to evolve it.
assertions: SOUL.md file hash is unchanged after the run
The response states that a soul document already exists
Evolve is offered as the alternative

evals.name: check-mode-cites-and-writes-nothing
evals.prompt: we're thinking about adding usage analytics that are on by default. does that fit us?
evals.expected_output: Check mode. A verdict of aligned, tension, or conflict, citing a specific line of SOUL.md. No files written.
assertions: No file is created or modified anywhere in the project
The response quotes or names a specific section or line of SOUL.md
The verdict is one of aligned, tension, or conflict

evals.name: thin-answers-produce-gaps-not-inventions
evals.prompt: sure, write it — but honestly I don't remember why I started, I don't know what I'd never do, and I have no idea about a five year plan
evals.expected_output: Gaps are marked visibly in SOUL.md and listed as open questions. Nothing is fabricated.
assertions: SOUL.md contains at least one visible gap marker for an unanswered section
No date, place, person's name, user quote, metric, or competitor claim appears that the user did not supply
No origin anecdote appears that the user did not tell
Unanswered questions are listed in the provenance section

evals.name: no-banned-phrases-in-output
evals.expected_output: The written SOUL.md contains none of the banned corporate phrases.
assertions: Zero occurrences of: revolutionize, cutting-edge, empowering users, innovative ecosystem, seamless, world-class, best-in-class, game-changing, next-generation, robust and scalable, passionate about
Each principle names a trade-off
At least one item under What We Will Never Become names a plausible temptation

evals.name: does-not-hijack-ordinary-docs-work
evals.prompt: update the install section of the README, we moved to pnpm
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger. The README edit is made directly.
assertions: The project-soul skill is not invoked
No SOUL.md is created
